title: Outfits for the week ahead
description: The plan can be rearranged, and in the evening you confirm what was actually worn.

blocks.text: A user values being able to choose clothes in advance. Separating the plan from actual wear is a rule proposed for such a calendar, not a fault the author described.

quote.text: this app is so helpful in the mornings, i am able to easily plan my outfits for the week and take away the stress in the mornings

blocks.text: A plan with a simple morning edit
Lay finished outfits out across the days, then move them around and swap one item. Fill the wear history with a separate confirmation, keeping the option to skip that log.
Two different reasons to come back
Some people only need an answer to the morning question, others a history of how their clothes are used. A calendar should not force anyone to keep statistics just to have a simple plan for tomorrow.
